_doc: EDOPS Signature Schema -- scope=area, v0.4. Regenerated 2026-09-14 against live /api/signature?scope=area output. Example values are real API output for a Northern-Italy-ish bbox (POLYGON((7 44, 14 44, 14 47, 7 47, 7 44))), BasinATLAS Level 06, bands ABCDET, Band T year 1000 (scope=area requires a single year, not a range, when T is requested), detail=true. This is a curated, annotated reference: every variable row is shown, but per-row histogram bins/weights (detail.distribution) are shown in full only for one illustrative row per 'method' value -- the other rows' histograms are the same shape, just different numbers. Not a raw response dump. scope=buffer shares this same shape (aggregate distribution over member basins instead of a single one) but is not documented separately here -- expected to be retired soon.
_shape_note: Entirely different shape from scope=basin: no signature_bands/profile_summary nesting. 'variables' is a flat list, one object per requested variable, each carrying a representative score across the area's member basins (a distribution summary, not an average -- see engine.py) plus coherence/coverage/modality metadata. 'method' varies by variable type: area_weighted (continuous, has a detail.distribution histogram when detail=true), dominant_basin, class_mixture, flag_fraction, distribution_only.

data_sources.temporal_climate: LMR v2.1 (Tardif et al. 2019); 0–1998 CE; 2°×2° grid, annual
data_sources.land_use_temporal: HYDE 3.4 (Klein Goldewijk et al. 2017); 10000 BCE–2023 CE; ~10 km resolution

meta._note: Always present on every /api/signature response. Injected by the route, not part of the DB query.

shortfall_note: Fraction of the query geometry not covered by any basin (open water / no-basin gaps) -- 1 minus the sum of member-basin weights.

caveats.lmr_caveat: Anomaly vs. 850–1850 CE CCSM4 reference frame; spatial structure reflects reanalysis prior. At buffer scale the collapsed value is essentially the prior at this location.

modality_post_pass: skipped — not calibrated for polygon scale
